description_en: Call DescribeLayer4Rules to query the detailed configuration of port forwarding rules for DDoS protection instances
description_zh: 调用DescribeLayer4Rules查询DDoS高防实例端口转发规则的详细配置
name: DescribeLayer4Rules

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request. You do not need to fill this in; it is automatically obtained by the system
parameters.help_zh: 请求源ip。无需填写，系统自动获取
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the DDoS protection instance to be queried.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91478.html to query all DDoS protection instance IDs
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的DDoS高防实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91478.html查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of forwarding protocol. Values:
tcp: Indicates TCP protocol.
udp: Indicates UDP protocol
parameters.help_zh:
转发协议类型。取值：
tcp：表示TCP协议。
udp：表示UDP协议
parameters.name: forward_protocol

parameters.help_en: In paginated queries, specifies which page of data to return. The minimum value is 1, indicating the first page of data
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，返回第几页数据。最小值为1，表示返回第1页数据
parameters.name: offset

parameters.help_en: In paginated queries, specifies the number of results per page. The maximum value is 50, indicating that each page can contain up to 50 results
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页包含结果的数量。最大值为50，表示每页最多包含50个结果
parameters.name: page_size
